notes.message: MagicLib can only say "only with" these mods (required_mods_id): "only without" and "any one of" are left out.
The prerequisite "$player.tsa_x == 2" isn't a true/false flag in $global memory, which is all MagicLib can test. Left out.

The prerequisite "quest tsa_hunt ended": that quest is exported only as a bounty, so SagaLib never ends it. Test its bounty's own key instead ($global.<bounty>_succeeded, a flag prerequisite). Left out.
MagicLib can't give ships, XP: left out of the bounty.
MagicLib names only the flagship: the other ships' names are left out.
MagicLib has no "intercept-player" order: the fleet waits at its place.
MagicLib can't: "Size at least" (a market target only says the faction). The bounty leaves it out.
